objective: USINE V3.5's shipped example inputs/init.TEST.par run in place with 'usine -l' (USINE's own inputs, unmodulated B/C): the reference of acceptance B1X-2 and B1X-3

extension.input_manifest_note: USINE's shipped file (GPL-2.0), hashed where it lies and never copied; it reads its other inputs through $USINE/inputs/

tools.name: USINE
tools.version: V3.5 (git tag V3.5, commit fb53006db41d1a640bf1b5af1a4b0f899ca59673; built with Apple clang 21.0.0 against ROOT 6.38.04)

seeds.note: USINE's local-flux calculation is deterministic: no random numbers are drawn

tolerances.note: those of init.TEST.par (EPS_ITERCONV 1e-6, EPS_INTEGR 1e-4, EPS_NORMDATA 1e-10); outputs printed with 6 significant digits

extension.exit_status_note: exit_status 0: both B/C tables written, no USINE error or crash in the log; USINE V3.5 itself returns 1 on every path (usine_exit_status)
notes: only the two B/C tables are kept; phi = 0 (unmodulated) is asked on the command line
